label: Whatever is INFINITE_1, in the primitive sense of…, by Infinity excludes received…
rule: Infinity excludes received esse, so the infinite is its own being
meaning: Whatever is infinite has unlimited esse (STMT-INFINITE-ESSE-IS-UNLIMITED, q.7 a.1 'infinitum ... ex eo quod non est finitum'); its esse is then received in nothing, since received esse is limited (STMT-RECEIVED-ESSE-IS-LIMITED, q.7 a.2); so it is its own being (STMT-UNRECEIVED-ESSE-IS-OWN-BEING, q.7 a.1); what is its own being has every perfection of being (STMT-OWN-BEING-HAS-EVERY-PERFECTION-OF-BEING, SCG I.28 as encoded); and every pure perfection is a perfection of being (STMT-PURE-PERFECTIONS-PERTAIN-TO-BEING, q.4 a.2 as encoded). Derives the former bare bridge STMT-INFINITE-HAS-EVERY-PURE-PERFECTION. All five premises stay open.
